meta.title: Ship client-ready monthly reporting with one repeatable workflow
meta.description: Agencies rebuild client reports manually each cycle, creating delays, inconsistency, and low client confidence.

props.headline: Ship client-ready monthly reporting with one repeatable workflow
props.subheadline: Ship client-ready monthly reporting with one repeatable workflow
props.problem_statement: Agencies rebuild client reports manually each cycle, creating delays, inconsistency, and low client confidence.

props.title: Try the workflow assistant
props.prompt_placeholder: e.g. We spend too long rebuilding monthly reports for non-technical clients.

props.title: Why this approach
items: Build reports with custom fields and data from other apps (1782 reviews)
Single reporting template reused across clients with controlled customization.
Weekly QA loop to improve clarity and trust with each reporting cycle.

props.title: Validation target
props.target: At least 5 qualified leads from first 20 targeted users in 14 days

props.title: Guardrails
items: Fewer than 2 qualified intent captures after 20 targeted visitors
Core workflow completion rate below 20% in first-session usage

props.title: Start with one pilot workflow
props.description: Join pilot to standardize KPI narratives and cut report prep time.

items.question: Will this remove analyst judgment?
items.answer: No. It standardizes baseline structure so analyst time goes to interpretation, not formatting.

items.question: Can we keep client-specific KPI sets?
items.answer: Yes. The template has shared core blocks plus client-specific metric sections.
